preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: s consists only of lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase English letters 'a' through 'z'.

postconditions.expression: output is either -1 or a permutation of numbers 1 through n
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 if it's impossible to find a valid permutation P, or a permutation P of numbers 1 through n such that applying P on s results in a palindromic string.
